answer: Keep every identity's work in one shared lagoon ledger that anyone can read. Each epoch a falcon auditor is drawn at random and lands on one island — a single identity's home base — then re-derives that identity's latest task from the lagoon, checking each input and output step by step. An honest agent passes with one task per epoch. A fake with no real work loses its island and its vote. An attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand real, re-derivable tasks every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
